levels.surface: محمد بن عبد الله بن نمير

notes: Two taḥwīl branches: the first ends at مروان / علي بن مسهر, the second at a father-relation; both meet at موسى الجهني, written in each branch, so the names after the last «ح» form the shared tail
«- واللفظ له -» is a gloss; «حدثنا أبي» (Numayr's father) and «حدثني أبي» (Mus'ab's father) are bare kinship words: relation links, not named
Occurrence counts: the word أبي first stands in «أبي شيبة»
